{"title":"NeuroGen Corp Negotiation Package Preparation","content":"## Plan Overview

This plan constructs a comprehensive negotiation package for the NeuroGen Corp licensing deal across four parallel workstreams, then synthesizes everything into a unified deliverable.

### Workstreams:
1. **Technical Dossier** - Synthesize crystal structure data, SAR analysis, and 200-compound pilot results into a professional technical summary
2. **Term Sheet Framework** - Draft licensing terms prioritizing speed (12-month), cost (€2.5M cap), and IP (CNS-only exclusivity to NeuroGen, all non-CNS retained)
3. **Equity-for-Speed Proposal** - Structure the 5% equity offer (€2.5M value at €50M pre-money) for 3-month timeline acceleration, with valuation justification
4. **Fallback Position Matrix** - Define escalation tiers: equity to 7.5%, timeline to 15 months, budget to €2.75M (never reduce IP scope)
5. **Final Assembly** - Merge all components into a cohesive, presentation-ready negotiation package
